::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [<i>c</i>. 1870?]  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Miss Dampier](people/person_1345.qmd),

Here are your books with many thanks, and the Scotch one. It is the Edinburgh baillie who is worth reading—the other is <u>horrid</u>. I will get the rest of Mademoiselle as soon as I can and send her or bring her.[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M  Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps *Mémoires de Mademoiselle de Montpensier* ed. Adolphe Cheruel 4 vols (Paris: Charpentier 1858-9).
